name: Adult Blue Dracolich
source: ActiveWorkspace shared catalog enriched by audited RandomEncounters data

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the dracolich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The dracolich has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The dracolich can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) lightning damage.

abilities.name: Claw
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) slashing damage.

abilities.name: Tail
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

abilities.name: Frightful Presence
abilities.description: Each creature of the dracolich's choice that is within 120 feet of the dracolich and aware of it must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the dracolich's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

abilities.name: Lightning Breath (Recharge 5-6)
abilities.description: The dracolich exhales lightning in a 90-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 66 (12d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

random_encounters.senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 22

legendaryActions.name: Detect
legendaryActions.description: The dracolich makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendaryActions.name: Tail Attack
legendaryActions.description: The dracolich makes a tail attack.

legendaryActions.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The dracolich beats its tattered wings. Each creature within 10 ft. of the dracolich must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw or take 14 (2d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. After beating its wings this way, the dracolich can fly up to half its flying speed.

homebrewAlignment.name: Lawful Renegade
homebrewAlignment.description: A rebel in legal robes. They bend laws to suit their gain while pretending to be team players - calculating, efficient, and just manipulative enough to get ahead.
